name: motion-studio-desktop
description: ComfyUI-style desktop viewer host for Motion Studio (vendor-boundary plan §10.2, Slice C): an Electron shell that launches the local Studio server on a REAL Node runtime, shows the Studio web UI for the human adviser, and owns the child's lifecycle. The AI connects over MCP exactly as without the shell. Private — never part of the npm install artifact; Electron is a devDependency of this folder only.
